title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-27
lineage: Playback on Nakamich BX-100 > Panasonic SV 3700 DAT> Tascam CD-RW 700> EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: FOB  Sennheiser 441s > Sony D5 > Sony D5 (first gen CM)

ai_review.summary: Great second‑set performance highlighted by a scorching Scarlet Begonias, captured on an audience tape of fair but decent quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the second set, calling it one of the all‑time great lists and noting an intense Scarlet solo. The recording is an audience source; sound quality isn’t stellar but is acceptable compared with many other AUDs from that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives high praise (all‑time great second set, intense solo) while recording is only fair; weighted average yields a solid 4+ rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as not great but better than many other audience recordings; generally listenable with some clarity limitations.

show_quality.setlist_flow: All‑time great second‑set list with strong transitions and high energy.
